From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-10T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: MAP draft — security review & SOC 2 evidence (next steps)

Hi Elaine — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the MAP milestone for security review and SOC 2 package delivery.

Summary of call (2/10):
- FintechCo security will run a focused review of our SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence manifest.
- Your team requested a completed questionnaire + a prioritized evidence list (minimal set to validate controls) by next week for your initial assessment.
- We agreed on a target for a full evidence bundle delivery after your review, contingent on any follow-up asks.

What I captured as MAP milestones (proposed):
1) Send initial SOC 2 questionnaire (Grace) — due: 2026-02-12
2) Provide prioritized evidence manifest (Marcus) — due: 2026-02-12
3) FintechCo security initial review and list of clarifying Qs (FintechCo) — due: 2026-02-16
4) Deliver full evidence bundle / archive (Grace + Rishi) — target: 2026-02-24 (depends on scope of clarifying Qs)

Dependencies/risks:
- If FintechCo requests screenshots or timeboxed logs, delivery may shift — we will triage which items are blocker vs. nice-to-have.
- Redaction required on some customer-specific logs; Rishi will own SSO/PII redaction guidance.

Attachments included with this email:
- SOC2 questionnaire (first draft) — see attached PDF
- Evidence manifest (short list) — CSV attached

Asks / next steps for FintechCo:
- Elaine, please confirm (today or tomorrow) if the proposed dates work for your reviewers and whether we should include any additional stakeholders (e.g., vendor risk team).
- Security contact: please confirm who will own the 2/16 review and the preferred format for evidence intake (S3 link, secure upload, or DocuSign for attestations).

I'll follow up once I hear back and will update the MAP in the shared Drive.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
